system.description: The mage can control an existing flame by cutting off or supplying oxygen to the fire in specific directions or space. For example, the mage can open a passage free of flame in the middle of an inferno, make a fire stretch and spread to places where it is not currently burning, or even suffocate it completely. The area of flame that the mage controls can be as large as a small room.
